target_company.name: Shein
target_company.description: Ultra-low-cost, trend-driven apparel and goods shipped direct from China to consumers globally

peer_selection.rationale: Selected fast fashion and apparel retail companies. Note: Shein's e-commerce model differs from traditional retail. ITX (Inditex/Zara) and HM (H&M) are primary comps.

special_considerations: Valuation range $30-45B depending on source and timing
Q1 2025 showed strong rebound: $10B revenue, $400M+ net income
Pure-play e-commerce model vs traditional retail comparables
Facing regulatory pressure in US and Europe over tariffs and fast fashion practices
Lower margins than SaaS companies but massive scale
notes.data_quality: Revenue figures from multiple sources including FT, Bloomberg, Sacra. Some variance exists ($38B-$50B reported). Using conservative $38B.
notes.valuation_context: January 2024 secondary market at $45B. Seeking London IPO at $30B valuation (under pressure). Peak was $100B in 2022.
notes.comparability_notes: Shein's direct-from-China model and ultra-low prices create different unit economics than traditional fast fashion. Lower multiples reflect retail vs tech business model. Inditex (Zara) is closest operational comparable despite different distribution model.
